FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

Frequently asked questions

What people ask most about sessions, digital products and payments.

How do the one-on-one sessions work?

They are individual sessions, 100 % online via Google Meet, lasting 45 minutes. You will receive the link to join 30 minutes before the session. More information on One-on-one session.

How much does a session cost and how do I pay?

US$50 per session. Payment is made in advance to confirm and book your session.

Are sessions available in English?

Yes. Sessions are offered in English and in Spanish.

Can I reschedule my session?

Yes, with at least 24 hours' notice. If you let us know on the same day as the session, it is not refunded or rescheduled.

What topics can we work on in the sessions?

Emotional wellbeing, breathing and relaxation, yoga and qigong, nutrition and healthy habits, home fermentation, and wellbeing through life stages such as menopause. Also lifestyle habits of people living with diabetes, anxiety or depression, from the perspective of self-care, education and complementary support.

What is Your Habit Map and how do I get it?

It is a personalized PDF guide for US$9.99. You pay with PayPal and then answer about 13 short questions, in about 4 minutes. The PDF is created on your device and downloads right away. More information on Your Habit Map.

What is My Digestive Garden?

An interactive guide with five stations about your habits, the digestive plate, home ferments such as kefir and sauerkraut, how soil and gut are alike, and a personal plan. At the end you download a personalized PDF. It costs US$25, one-time payment. More information on My Digestive Garden.

What is My Smart Plate?

An app to decide what to cook, plan a weekly menu with its shopping list and make the most of the ingredients you already have at home. Suggestions respect allergies, preferences and the health areas you choose. It costs US$39.99, one-time payment, with lifetime access, up to 5 devices and 5 profiles, in English and Spanish. More information on My Smart Plate.

How long do I have to use my purchase?

For Your Habit Map, My Digestive Garden and My Balance Map you have 30 days to redeem your payment and up to 5 accesses per payment. My Smart Plate includes lifetime access on up to 5 devices.

Are digital products refundable?

Digital products are paid through PayPal. Refund requests are governed by PayPal's refund policy.

Are my answers stored on a server?

No. In Your Habit Map and My Digestive Garden, your answers are processed only on your device: they are not sent to or stored on any server.

Does this replace medical or psychological care?

No. Holistic Wellness offers educational tools and personal support. It does not diagnose and does not replace professional medical or psychological care.

Have another question? Write to me and I will reply in writing.
